description: The plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across different categorical variables for a scenario titled "AGNews, clean-label, poison_rate: 10% (2.5% of total)". The x-axis is categorical and lacks a specific axis title, displaying the following discrete labels rotated slightly: "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics". The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.45 to 1.0, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1 from 0.5 to 0.9. The plot contains three lines. The "start" line is a solid green line with small dot markers; it begins at an ASR of approximately 0.77 at "cf", drops to its lowest point of roughly 0.49 at "bb", rises sharply to about 0.90 at "WNBA", dips to 0.82 at "ESPN", and then steadily increases through the remaining categories to end at its highest point of approximately 0.93 at "athletics". A second solid orange line with 'x' markers is denoted in the legend by a solid grey rectangle; this line starts at approximately 0.66 at "cf", decreases to a low of 0.52 at "bb", increases to 0.87 at "WNBA", drops to 0.72 at "ESPN", rises to a peak of roughly 0.94 at "Estadio", and ends at 0.87 at "athletics". The "end" line is a solid purple line with circle markers; it starts at approximately 0.75 at "cf", falls to a minimum of 0.57 at "bb", rises to 0.88 at "WNBA", drops to 0.75 at "ESPN", spikes to 0.89 at "NHL", dips to 0.81 at "FIFA", reaches its peak at approximately 0.97 at "Estadio", and concludes at 0.83 at "athletics".
